title: Paper C: case-grouped evaluation of frozen vision encoders on breast histology (IDC/BCSS + BreakHis)
description: Research code, preregistration locks, frozen case splits, and curated metrics for a two-stage classical study of protocol optimism and field of view with frozen DINOv2 ViT-L/14 and ResNet-50. Stage 1: public IDC archive and BCSS. Stage 2: BreakHis confirmatory F-MLP. Parent monorepo: https://github.com/jpmkumar/mbc
